question_text: Make five sentences using parts of sentences from each column of the table below. 1  5 =
stimulus: Efforts its interest without struggle Life become one kind of continuous examination Games loses dull if there is no competition A victory be not a real triumph if both sides are not equally matched Really, life extremely needed for the progress in life
guide_solution: (a) Charles Dickens was born on February 7, 1812 in Portsmouth. (b) He was one of the greatest English novelists of the 19th century. (c) When he was a small boy, his father was sent to prison for debt. (d) Dickens had to work in a factory at the age of twelve. (e) He could not go to school and receive education.
